blocks.text: Pichhli jamaaton ki hayatiyati tanzeem (biological organisation) ki satahon (levels) ko yaad karen, jahan aap ko hayatiyati molecules ka mukhtasar taaruf (introduction) mila tha. Ab aap carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids ko tafseel se parhenge, aur saath hi pani ki ahmiyat (importance) aur conjugated molecules ka kirdar (role) bhi.

blocks.title: Biochemistry
blocks.text: Biochemistry jandaron (organisms) mein hone wale kemiyai (chemical) ajza aur kemiyai amal ka mutala hai. Jandaron ki tamam banawat (structures) ek biochemical tanzeem rakhti hain, aur un ke tamam kaam is tanzeem mein hone wale biochemical amal ki wajah se hain. Is liye biochemistry ka bunyadi ilm jandaron ki anatomy aur physiology samajhne mein madad deta hai: photosynthesis, tanaffus (respiration), hazma (digestion), sukarna (contraction) waghaira sab biochemical alfaz mein bayan ho sakte hain.

Zameen par zindagi pani mein paida hui, aur tamam zindagi ab bhi pani par munhasir (dependent) hai. Jandaron ke jism (protoplasm) ka kam az kam 80 fisad pani hai, aur zindagi ke taqreeban tamam kemiyai reactions pani ke mahlool (aqueous solutions) mein hote hain. Jandaron ko banane wale doosre kemiyai madde zyada tar organic macromolecules aur kuch inorganic molecules hain.

blocks.title: Organic molecules
blocks.text: Woh molecules jo cells banate hain aur jin mein carbon hota hai organic molecules hain. Yeh qudrati taur par sirf jandaron ke jism mein ya un ki paidawar aur baqiyat mein milte hain. Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids jandaron ke aham organic molecules hain.

Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids jandaron ke khushk wazan (dry mass) ka 93 fisad banate hain. Baqi 7 fisad chhote organic molecules (jaise vitamins) aur inorganic molecules (jaise carbon dioxide, tezab (acids), bases aur namak (salts)) par mushtamil hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karen: metabolism
blocks.text: Jandar ki zindagi us ke cells ki musalsal kemiyai sargarmiyon par munhasir hai. Cell ke andar hone wale tamam kemiyai reactions ko mila kar metabolism kehte hain. Is ke amal ya to anabolism hain, jis mein saada madde mil kar pecheeda (complex) madde banate hain, ya catabolism, jis mein pecheeda molecules toot kar saada bante hain.

blocks.title: Functional groups
blocks.text: Organic molecules ka markaz carbon par mabni hai jis se atoms ke khaas groups jure hote hain, yeh functional groups hain, maslan OH, CO, COOH aur NH2. Zyada tar biochemical reactions mein ek functional group ek molecule se doosre ko muntaqil (transfer) hota hai, ya carbon-carbon bond toot-ta hai.

Zyada tar organic molecules bare hote hain, aur biologists unhen macromolecules kehte hain. Bohat se macromolecules polymers hain: polymer aisa molecule hai jo bohat si ek jaisi ikaiyon (units), monomers, se bana ho. Aham macromolecules carbohydrates, proteins aur nucleic acids saada monomers ke polymers hain, yani bil-tarteeb sugars, amino acids aur nucleotides ke.

blocks.caption: Chaar bunyadi hayatiyati molecules aur un ke monomers
rows: Sahi polymers nahin: glycerol aur fatty acids, ya doosri ikaiyan

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa group protoplasm ke khushk wazan ka aadha banata hai, aur us ka monomer kya hai? Chaar groups mein se kaun sa ek dohrai hui monomer ka polymer nahin?
blocks.explanation: Proteins khushk wazan ka 50 fisad banate hain; un ke monomers amino acids hain. Lipids ek dohrai hui monomer ke polymers nahin; yeh glycerol aur fatty acids jaisi ikaiyon se bante hain.

items: Biochemistry jandaron ke kemiyai ajza aur amal parhti hai; pani protoplasm ka kam az kam 80 fisad aur us ke reactions ka zariya (medium) hai.

Organic molecules mein carbon hota hai aur cells unhen banate hain. Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids khushk wazan ka 93 fisad hain (50, 18, 15 aur 10 fisad); baqi vitamins aur inorganic molecules.
Metabolism anabolism (banana) aur catabolism (torna) hai. Macromolecules aksar monomers ke polymers hain: sugars, amino acids, nucleotides.
